response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(length) as val FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL), rating_avgs AS (SELECT AVG(length) as avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), first_cut AS (SELECT avg_length FROM rating_avgs WHERE avg_length > (SELECT val FROM overall_avg)), first_cut_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) as val FROM first_cut), second_cut AS (SELECT avg_length FROM first_cut WHERE avg_length > (SELECT val FROM first_cut_mean)) SELECT AVG(avg_length) as mean_of_remaining, AVG(avg_length - (SELECT val FROM overall_avg)) as avg_above_overall, AVG(avg_length - (SELECT val FROM first_cut_mean)) as avg_above_first_cut_mean FROM second_cut
